audience: managed service providers and IT teams who monitor client networks in Auvik

useCases.title: Find devices that are offline now
useCases.text: List the tenants first. Then list devices by status to see which ones are offline.

useCases.title: Review critical alerts from the last day
useCases.text: List alerts by severity and time window. Open one alert to read its description, status and external ticket data.

useCases.title: Read bandwidth and CPU of a device
useCases.text: Read device metrics over a time range, such as bandwidth, CPU or memory, per minute, hour or day.

useCases.title: Map the networks and interfaces of a device
useCases.text: List the networks Auvik discovered, such as routed and VLAN networks. List the interfaces with their addresses and status.

useCases.title: Dismiss an alert that is handled
useCases.text: Read the alert, then dismiss it in Auvik so it no longer shows as active.
